# Skill Manifest Check

> Lint a SKILL.md for missing frontmatter, a description too vague to trigger, overlapping triggers and body size. Free, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/skill-manifest-check/)
- [How to write a description that actually triggers](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/skill-manifest-check/how-to-write-a-description-that-triggers.html)
- [Skill Manifest Check vs. reading the SKILL.md by hand](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/skill-manifest-check/vs-reading-the-skill-by-hand.html)
